headlines.hostile: %s and %s are no longer on speaking terms.
headlines.partner: %s and %s are doing business together. Openly.

collective.partner: "You've been good to us. People here remember that, and we don't forget much."
collective.neutral: "We're square. Not friends, not strangers. Let's keep it tidy."
collective.businessRival: "You're working our ground. We've noticed. So has everyone who eats off it."
collective.hostile: "We're done being polite. Stay out of Hackney."

firm.partner: "You've been useful. The Firm keeps a list of useful people. You're on the short one."
firm.businessRival: "You're selling into our market. We're a patient firm, but we do keep minutes."
firm.hostile: "You've made yourself a line item. We close those."

guild.partner: "The Court has minuted its appreciation. Rarely done. Frame it if you like."
guild.neutral: "Your file has been returned to the general cabinet."
guild.businessRival: "The Court notes you now work materials it regards as its own. A formal note. They escalate."
guild.hostile: "The Court has struck your name from its courtesies. Expect the Guild to act accordingly."

network.partner: "You're on the list of people we pass things to. Try to stay on it."
network.neutral: "Nothing personal. Nothing at all, in fact."
network.businessRival: "You're trading in things we trade in. We've started a file."
network.hostile: "We know where you sleep. That used to be a service."

conclave.partner: "The Conclave regards you as a friend. Please don't make us revise that in writing."
conclave.neutral: "We have no view on you at present. That is a comfortable place to be."
conclave.businessRival: "You've entered a market we manage. We'll be managing you as well."
conclave.hostile: "The Conclave has taken a position on you. It is not a supportive one."

producer.warning: "You're working ground we work. Mind how much of it you take."
producer.market: "We'll answer you in the market first. It's cheaper for everyone."

crafter.warning: "The Court has opened a file on your trading. Files are rarely closed."
crafter.market: "The Guild will now conduct its business as though you were a competitor. You are."
crafter.raid: "The Court has authorised other measures. Hired ones."

informationBroker.warning: "People are asking about you. We haven't answered. Yet."
informationBroker.market: "Your name's for sale now. We'd rather it wasn't, but there it is."
informationBroker.raid: "We know where you keep things. That was the polite version."

manipulator.warning: "Your activity has been noted in a ledger you will never see."
manipulator.market: "The market will be less generous to you. It has been advised."
manipulator.raid: "The Conclave does not raid. It has other ways of closing an account."

veinRaid.hit: "That was us in %s. You were working our side of the street."
veinRaid.miss: "We came for your vein in %s. You held it. This time."

collective.flood: "We've put a lot of %s calc on the market. Cheap. See how you like selling against it."
collective.withhold: "We're not selling %s this week. Not to anyone. You'll work out why."
collective.outbid: "The site in %s is ours now. You were slow."
collective.lowballBuyout: "We'll take your vein in %s off you. £%d. It's not what it's worth. It's what you can get."

veinRaid.hit: "%s was a hostile acquisition. We'll send the paperwork."
veinRaid.miss: "Our people were turned back in %s. They'll be reviewed. So will you."

shortfallSteal.hit: "We were short. Your vein in %s wasn't. That's been corrected."
shortfallSteal.miss: "We sent people to your vein in %s for stock. They came back without it."

firm.flood: "We've released some %s stock at a discount. Your margins were never our concern."
firm.withhold: "The Firm has paused sales of %s. Supply will resume when it suits us."
firm.outbid: "We've acquired the site in %s. You were outbid. It happens."
firm.lowballBuyout: "The Firm will buy your %s vein for £%d. We price in your circumstances. Everyone does."

guild.poach: "%s have received a better offer for their renewal. Ours. You may match it."
guild.withholdItems: "The Guild will not be selling %s for the present. Our stock is spoken for."
guild.lowballBuyout: "The Court will take your vein in %s for £%d. The offer reflects your position, not the vein's."

network.lowballBuyout: "Someone wants your vein in %s. £%d. We'd take it before they stop wanting it."
network.sellIntel: "We sold a file on you to %s. Everything in it was true."
network.priceGouge: "Our prices to you have gone up, for %s days. Call it a risk premium."
network.disinformation: "What you think you know about %s is out of date. We saw to that."

conclave.lowballBuyout: "The Conclave will relieve you of the vein in %s. £%d. Liquidity is a kindness at a time like this."
conclave.undercut: "London will find %s cheaper this week. Not from you."
conclave.denyGoods: "The Conclave has taken an interest in %s. Every unit that was for sale."
conclave.tickerPush: "The Conclave expects %s. Markets tend to agree with us, eventually."

explainers.shortfallSteal: "The Firm ran short of something it needs and helped itself from your vein. They'll do it whatever they think of you, unless you're partners. Guards help. So does them not running short."
explainers.veinRaid: "That's a raid. They'll keep at it while they're this sore with you. Guards and an alarm on the vein help, or give them a reason to like you."
explainers.flood: "That's a flood. They've dumped your ore on London below the quote to drag the price down. Costs them too. Hold your stock a few days if you can."
explainers.withhold: "They're sitting on their stock so you can't buy it. It'll ease in a week. Find another seller or craft around it."
explainers.outbid: "They got to a site you'd found before you claimed it. Claim the good ones quick while they're watching you."
explainers.poach: "Someone's undercut your renewal. Match their price and the buyer stays. Leave it and they walk."
explainers.withholdItems: "The Guild's stopped selling you what you need. A week, usually. Buy elsewhere or make it yourself."
explainers.lowballBuyout: "That's a vulture's offer. Under what the vein's worth, and they know you're short. Take it only if you must."
explainers.undercut: "The Conclave's selling what you sell, under your price. Buyers go to them. Hold your stock or sell where they aren't."
explainers.denyGoods: "The Conclave's bought up what you need and it's sitting on it. Dearer and scarcer for a week. Make it yourself or wait."
explainers.tickerPush: "The Conclave's leaning on the Ticker, towards the weather that hurts what you sell. It's slow. Watch the Ticker and sell before it turns."
explainers.sellIntel: "The Network's sold what it knows about you to people who don't like you. They'll hit harder and pick better. Pay the handler for privacy and it stops."
explainers.priceGouge: "The Network's charging you over the odds. Its shop and its handler both. It'll ease in a couple of weeks. Buy what you can elsewhere."
explainers.disinformation: "The Network's muddied your file on a rival. Don't trust what you think you know about them. Buy fresh intel before you act on it."

veinRaid.playerMiss: Raided your vein in %s and was turned back.

shortfallSteal.playerHit: Stripped your vein in %s to cover a shortfall.
shortfallSteal.playerMiss: Went for your vein in %s to cover a shortfall and was turned back.
shortfallSteal.attackerHit: Stripped %s's vein in %s to cover a shortfall.

stockpileRaid.defenderHit: %s cleaned out our stockpile in %s. Moving it.
stockpileRaid.defenderMiss: Saw %s off our stockpile in %s. Moving it anyway.

outbid.player: Claimed your site in %s before you could.

poach.lapsed: Took %s off you. You didn't match.

lowballBuyout.player: Offered to buy your vein in %s cheap.

tickerPush.player: Pushed the Ticker toward %s against you.
tickerPush.defender: %s pushed the Ticker toward %s against us.

sellIntel.player: Sold a file on you to %s.
sellIntel.defender: %s sold a file on us to %s.

priceGouge.player: Raised its prices to you for %s days.

headlines.veinTaken: %s vein in %s changes hands: %s out, %s in.
headlines.flood: %s floods London with cut-price %s, aimed at %s.

headlines.position: Someone's buying up %s calc, and not in small lots.

collective.done: "That's sorted, then. I won't forget it."
collective.failed: "You said you would. Never mind. I'll know next time."

firm.done: "Noted. The Firm keeps a list, and you're on the good half of it."
firm.failed: "We had an arrangement. We'll adjust our expectations."

guild.done: "The Court has recorded your assistance. It records very little."
guild.failed: "The Court notes the undertaking was not met."

conclave.done: "Thank you. We don't say it often, so it tends to be remembered."
conclave.failed: "A pity. We'll plan around you next time."

collective.priceFavour: "Go on then. Mate's rates for a few days. Don't tell Des."
collective.how: "One of ours drinks where theirs drink."
collective.leak: "Thought you'd want this. It's what we know about the %s."
collective.troubleGoods: "We're short of %s. Could you spare %d at £%d? It'd see us through."
collective.troublePremium: "Money's tight. Would you take %d %s off us at £%d? We need the cash more than the stock."
collective.troubleCash: "I hate asking. Could you lend us £%d? We'll remember it."
collective.thanks: "You came through. That won't be forgotten."

firm.priceFavour: "Approved. Preferred-partner pricing for the next few days."
firm.how: "We share a supplier with them. Suppliers talk."
firm.leak: "Attached, our current file on the %s. For your records."
firm.troubleGoods: "The Firm is short of %s. We'd take %d at £%d, if you can supply."
firm.troublePremium: "A cash-flow matter. We'd sell you %d %s at £%d."
firm.troubleCash: "A short-term facility of £%d would be appreciated."
firm.thanks: "Noted, and appreciated. The Firm keeps a ledger of these things."

guild.priceFavour: "The Court will allow you a partner's rate. Briefly."
guild.how: "Their buyer files his papers at our counter."
guild.leak: "The Court's notes on the %s. Read, then forget where you got them."
guild.troubleGoods: "The Court is short of %s. It would accept %d at £%d."
guild.troublePremium: "The Court will release %d %s to you at £%d. It needs the cash."
guild.troubleCash: "The Court requests £%d. It will be minuted as a loan."
guild.thanks: "Received. The Court remembers its friends, in writing."

network.how: "We sold them the map. We know where they're going."

conclave.priceFavour: "Of course. A little consideration, for a few days."
conclave.how: "We hold some of their paper. One hears things."
conclave.leak: "A small kindness. Our notes on the %s."
conclave.troubleGoods: "We find ourselves short of %s. Might you part with %d at £%d?"
conclave.troublePremium: "We'd let %d %s go to you at £%d. Liquidity, you understand."

log.warnedPair: Warned by %s of a raid from %s
log.tradeHelp: Sold %s to %s at a partner's rate
log.tradeHelped: Bought %s from %s at a partner's rate

nadia.cash: "Money's always welcome here. Don't make a habit of it or I'll start owing you."
nadia.item: "That's kind. It'll go in the cupboard with the others."
nadia.liked: "Oh, now you've been paying attention. Thank you."

des.cash: "Cash. Right. I'll put it towards boots."
des.item: "Ta. Not sure what I'll do with it, but ta."
des.liked: "That's the stuff. You'd make a decent prospector, knowing that."

hakim.cash: "I'll put it to the shop. Thank you, friend."
hakim.item: "A gift is a gift. I'll find it a use."

lusk.cash: "Received. The Firm appreciates contributions made without being asked."

ingram.cash: "The Court will record this as a donation. It declines to record anything else."
ingram.liked: "Assayed, and it passes. You have some taste after all."

fairweather.cash: "How thoughtful. We'll find somewhere discreet to put it."
fairweather.liked: "You've done some reading. The Conclave does appreciate that."

disinformationModes.inverted: They go for your strongest veins

networkMenu.gatedReason: The handler won't sell you that yet.

lines.raidIntel: "Here's who has you on their list this week."
lines.raidIntelNone: "Nobody's planning anything against you this week. Ask again next week."
lines.marketIntel: "Big trades coming. Who's dumping, who's buying."
lines.marketIntelNone: "Nothing big planned on the market this week."
lines.boost: "Here's what I have on %s. It's in your file now."
lines.raidWarnings: "If anyone sends people at your veins, you'll hear it from me first. Good for %d days."
lines.raidWarning: "%s have people heading for your %s vein. Tonight, most likely."
lines.privacy: "Nobody buys anything on you from us for %d days. After that, they can."
lines.inverted: "%s now think your strongest veins are your softest. For %d days."
lines.overestimate: "%s now think you're better guarded than you are. For %d days."
lines.reduction: "%s know less about you than they did yesterday."

moveLabels.shortfallSteal: a raid on your %s vein, for its ore
moveLabels.outbid: a bid for a site in %s
moveLabels.poach: a cheaper offer to one of your buyers
moveLabels.lowballBuyout: a low offer for one of your veins
moveLabels.sellIntel: selling your file to your rivals
moveLabels.disinformation: muddying your file on a rival

networkMenu.privateReason: "They've paid for quiet. I can't sell you that one for now."

nags.text: "This war's costing us. Not fatal yet. Worth deciding how it ends before they decide for us."
"Books are bleeding. Every raid we lose, we pay for twice. Find a way out."
"We can't keep this up. Next decent offer, we listen."

extremeNag.text: "We're done. Next peace offer that comes, we take it. We can argue the terms, not the deal."

factionWar.explainer: "That's a war now. While it lasts every loss wears us down, and them. It ends when both sides go quiet for %d days, or someone signs a peace."

log.endedPair: The war with %s has gone quiet.
log.endedPlayer: The war with you has gone quiet.

log.endedPair: The truce with %s has run its course.
log.endedPlayer: The truce with you has run its course.

offerLines.firm: "Mr Lusk would like this finished. Fourteen days' quiet, to start. Come and talk terms."
offerLines.guild: "The Court proposes a truce. Terms are open to discussion, within reason."
offerLines.network: "Everyone's losing money. We'd like to stop. Name your price, then hear ours."
offerLines.collective: "We're bleeding people for this. Let's talk before there's no one left to talk."
offerLines.conclave: "This has stopped paying, for either of us. The Conclave will hear terms."

lines.refused: "We're not ready to stop. Ask again when you've something worth hearing."

log.failed: Peace talks with you broke down.

paymentNotify.short: Truce payment to %s: £%d of £%d. You couldn't cover the rest.
